verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is a government filing service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers web-portal filing, payment, e-signature and tracking, with no mention of any MCP server or agent endpoint. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe concerns a separate state data API, not an MCP server for this product, so it earns no credit.
